reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) directly demonstrates that adding 50 at.% Pt to an FeCoNiMnCu HEA film and applying RTA produces an L1₀ phase with a three-order-of-magnitude coercivity increase, and explains the mechanism via reduced symmetry and spin–orbit coupling. The baseline coercivity (<100 Oe) is also supported, though the hypothesis extends the claim from FeCoNiMnCu to FeCoNi-based alloys, a minor gap.
premises: Adding ~50 at.% Pt to an fcc HEA thin film can yield an L1₀ phase after RTA
The L1₀ phase has reduced lattice symmetry and strong spin–orbit coupling, giving high magnetocrystalline anisotropy
This L1₀ transformation can increase coercivity by up to three orders of magnitude
The baseline fcc FeCoNi-based films have coercivity <100 Oe
RTA on Si/SiO₂ is an effective method to induce the L1₀ ordering
